def weave : List α → List α → List α
  | [], ys => ys
  | x :: xs, ys => x :: weave ys xs
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length

def deal : List α → List α × List α
  | [] => ([], [])
  | x :: xs => let p := deal xs; (x :: p.2, p.1)

theorem deal_weave (xs ys : List α) (h : xs.length = ys.length) : deal (weave xs ys) = (xs, ys) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons y ys => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons y ys =>
          have h' : xs.length = ys.length := by simpa using h
          simp [weave, deal, ih ys h']
'@ | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 Main.lean
lean Main.lean"
